name: Flunarizine
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Flunarizine is highly protein-bound (over 99%), metabolized by the liver and excreted very slowly, with negligible urinary excretion; its terminal half-life is about 19 days. The Canadian product monograph does not address kidney impairment or dialysis. It has no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: The product monograph does not address kidney impairment; bands shown on creatinine clearance (CrCl).

bands.recommendation: Migraine prophylaxis: 10 mg once daily in the evening (adults under 65); stop after 3 months if no response (PM).
The product monograph does not address kidney impairment. Renal excretion is negligible (under 0.2% in urine over 48 hours). Use with caution and specialist judgment.

monitoring: Depression (contraindicated with a history of depression), extrapyramidal symptoms (higher risk in older adults), sedation, weight gain; stop at the first sign. Review at 3 months and closely beyond 6 months (PM).
